propositions: rebar lacks an aggregation layer and time-series view of agent-driven dev-loop health, code-decay trends, and gate ROI across rich durable event history
three tier-C agent-lifecycle signal categories (env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug classification) leave no trace in the event store today and cannot be derived structurally

the command must surface all available metrics across three lenses (agent-loop health, codebase decay, gate value) via a single dynamic date-range rebar metrics CLI with no new agent-facing manual steps

tier-C blindspots are closed by minimal passive instrumentation stamped by trustworthy code (gate error handlers, git blame) rather than agent self-report, using a layered-hybrid derive-structural-plus-passive-emission pattern
bug-close friction must not increase: the required free-text reason is replaced (not supplemented) by a bounded --class enum persisted on STATUS events

blame-based caused_by auto-derivation is best-effort and non-authoritative, skipped when signals are ambiguous, never inserted into closed-source links via the graph guard but written directly to avoid silent rejection
